payload_entities.native_lifecycle: Parent native-like hurting-projectile tick runs first: trace/impact hook/deflection and move using current velocity, then concrete server timer-- and setFired true when timer<=0. Concrete timer<-160 discards. At exact timer0/-40, current Mob owner with nonnull target retargets power to target-center normalized vector times ordinary.2F/soul.25F; this branch has no local server guard and no zero-length normalization guard. Before fired, contact/block payload gates suppress explosions/damage but inherited trace/block callbacks still run. payload_entities.source_actor: Native current owner changes to DamageSource causing entity on server reflection; direct/causing explosion/contact sources follow the native source object.
payload_entities.native_lifecycle: Uses the same native parent motion/trace and server timer/fired/expiry as ordinary. Retarget power.2F at0/-40 only with totalBounces==0. Fired block contact with nonempty collisionshape calls inherited native onHitBlock, then explicitly calls block.onProjectileHit again, reflects only struck-face velocity component and sets power=reflectedVelocity*.05D. tickCount<=500 and bounces<=5 increments bounces, so0..5 allows six increments; a later eligible collision (or age>500) creates radius2 firetrue KEEP explosion/discards on server. It does not explode solely at age500 without collision. Pickable radius1; hurt rejects virtual native invulnerability, then markHurt; causing entity nonnull+fired returns true and server sets velocity to causing look vector,power*.1D,owner=causing entity. Damage amount is not used; reflected owner need not be original boss or Living. Bounce count is not reset on reflection. NBT preserves totalBounces,timer,fired,power and native owner.

facts.selection: Concrete tick decrements positive native cooldowns once, then unconditionally draws nextInt(3) for the poke choice. Locked phase/shield transition priority precedes offense. Alive AI idle actor with an alive target enters the ordered selection table; full stance means blockingProgress==10 OR swordProgress==10 except the second high-target MAGIC alternative. Native random draws short-circuit in order, not independent global proc rates. Normal/soul reinforced choice is nextInt(2), independent of phase. Horizontal swing writes cooldown160 but does not read it for entry. Goal follow-ups use existing animation state and target/motion predicates; STUN is only the locked effect-presence reader here.
facts.goal_chains: Priority1 offensive goals claim MOVE/JUMP/LOOK; idle AttackMoveGoal priority2 pursues but has no melee/damage call. Body-check normal writes target displacement*.25 at20, soul*.4F at16, Y0. Air smash writes target XZ displacement*.15,Y1.3 at19 (no target Y1.4) then onGround after19 ->SMASH. Reinforced variants do the same at84 (no target Y1.8), land after84 -> matching normal/soul smash. Horizontal/poke goals add forward*.3*clamped distance (clamps10/15; poke no-target adds unit forward); combo1 adds forward*.35*clamp(distance,0,5) at15/36/71, then target-nonnull at84 ->COMBO2. Predictive uppercut/combo2 snapshot initial targetXZ; before charge27 compute floor(currentXZ+(currentXZ-initialXZ)/27*12), then at27 write displacement*.3F,Y0 and clear target vector; stop also clears it. Uppercut retains target captured at goal start; combo2 rereads current target. Small swings/combo2 add forward1.5 at native ticks, subject to target-distance>3.5 where specified. Forced facing/zeroXZ preserve native windows. Before selection, floatStrider native lava support may setOnGround(true), feeding the air-smash landing gate; otherwise velocity is halved plus randomFloat*.5Y. Native canStandOnFluid accepts lava, with fluid affected/push overrides false. tick also calls the locked native repelEntities(1.4F,4F,1.4F,1.4F); its helper and native target pushes are reused, not new damage.
facts.melee_return: burn/Brand/heal/Combo/motion require the original hurttrue; shield disable does not; heal ignores effect-add return; no alive-after-hurt gate.
facts.body_vs_self_motion: Inverse squared horizontal-distance push is not native knockback and does not read native knockback-resistance here. Own body-check charge belongs to goal_motion, not this victim impulse. Status application and movement use hurt boolean, not measured HP loss; no post-hit alive gate.
facts.poke_mount_result: POKE_ATTACK1 tick39 arc70; second34 arc65; third29 arc60. Native tag gates mount only, not prior damage. Animation changes even if native riding is rejected. Do not flatten into knockback or synthesize a second effect.
facts.held_release: Cadence is native animation ticks, not an added periodic event. No separate victim team test in rider callback. True hurt ignites5 seconds and raw-stacks Brand+1 cap4,duration240; no heal.

facts.native_explosion: IgnisExplosion preserves native Explosion subclass construction, native DamageSources.explosion(this), default EntityBasedExplosionDamageCalculator for nonnull source (else default calculator). explode performs native ray/block resistance collection, query excluding the supplied direct source, mutable NeoForge onExplosionDetonate list, ignoreExplosion and distance<=2*radius/nonzero eye-direction gates. Native calculator determines requested amount and shouldDamageEntity; hurt return is discarded. Exposure/distance impulse includes native calculator knockback multiplier and Living EXPLOSION_KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE, then NeoForge getExplosionKnockback, additive motion and native onExplosionHit. Neither hurttrue nor shouldDamageEntity gates the motion callback. All reviewed callers pass KEEP, so finalize skips block destruction; firetrue still independently places native BaseFireBlock at eligible air-over-solid collected blocks with nextInt(3)==0, with no extra griefing check. Terminal Flame Strike firefalse skips fire placement.
facts.terrain: Locked hurt arms destroyBlocksTick20 before shared hurt, regardless of eventual rejection. Concrete blockbreak only AI/server with positive countdown decrements; at zero native canEntityGrief admits scan bbox.inflate.2 fromfloor(bossY) throughbboxmaxY. Nonair,canEntityDestroy,!IGNIS_IMMUNE and native onEntityDestroyBlock ->destroyBlock(withdrops,boss). This path does NOT read ignoreMobGriefing. Wave/ultimate cracked-tag removal has its separate ignoreMobGriefing OR native grief gate. Their spawned custom debris is locked non-damage/nonplacement; no spawned extra damage payload.
facts.alliance: isAlliedTo returns true for self, then native super team alliance, then TEAM_IGNIS tagged type only when both teams null. This is reused by body-check/poke/waves/local contact/phase/STUN/owned Flame Strike; AreaAttack sword helper deliberately has no ally reader. Several helpers separately exclude every Ignis irrespective of teams; fireball contact excludes Ignis only when current shooter is Ignis. Native explosion has no ally predicate. Flame Strike checks mutual nonalliance with its resolved caster.
facts.death: getDeathAnimation returns IGNIS_DEATH duration124; locked shared death progression uses duration-20 removal threshold104. Concrete AfterDefeatBoss requires supplied credited Living nonnull; asks native CMWorldData(level,NETHER); native get resolves that server dimension (overworld fallback if missing), computeIfAbsent native saved-data and setDirty when nonnull. Only a nonnull world record and prior false Ignis flag sets true and sends native first-defeat message; no respawner creation in this callback. Native getter/setter preserve flag; scoped save/load key IgnisDefeatedOnce. R2k5a altar does not read this flag, so no new spawn gate is inferred.
